## 1. Executive Overview

**vitRemote** is a production-grade Android remote assistance, screen-sharing, device management, real-time messaging, calling, and voice-driven AI automation application engineered by **Rubaeat Islam Raja (Arup Raja)**. Designed with a mobile-first, adaptive Material Design 3 interface in Jetpack Compose, vitRemote allows authorized users to pair Android devices across any Wi-Fi or cellular network anywhere in the world without requiring local IP discovery, port forwarding, or manual router configuration.

Every enrolled Android device receives a **permanent 9-digit connection code** (`XXX-XXX-XXX`) cryptographically anchored to the signed-in Google account via Jetpack Credential Manager and Firebase Authentication. Once signed in and configured through the guided 7-permission readiness checklist, users gain immediate access to:

- **Global Cloud Remote Screen Sharing:** Real-time frame streaming with adaptive resolution tiers (`360p`, `480p`, `720p`) and responsive frame-sequence tracking.
- **Full Remote Interaction:** Tap, long-press, directional swipe, vertical/horizontal scroll, soft keyboard text entry, Enter/Backspace actions, and system navigation (`Back`, `Home`, `Recents`, `Quick Settings`, `Notification Shade`, `Power Dialog`, `Wake`, `Lock`).
- **Virtual Screen Mode:** Background isolated app execution on an Android virtual display so remote operators can inspect or launch installed apps without disrupting the host phone's active screen.
- **Hardware & Telemetry Dashboard:** Live battery level, charging state, battery temperature, RAM utilization, internal storage consumption, screen pixel dimensions, active foreground package detection, remote flashlight toggle, high-volume find-phone ring alert, display brightness slider (`0–255`), and two-way clipboard synchronization.
- **Live Notification Mirroring:** Instant reading of active host notifications via `NotificationListenerService`.
- **Built-In Messenger & Audio/Video Calling:** Participant-scoped real-time text threads, zero-permission Photo Picker image attachments, call history logging, and full-duplex live audio and camera video calls.
- **6-Button AI Voice & Chat Assistant:** Hands-free device automation for Virtual Screen AI, Remote Screen AI, Own Device Voice AI, conversational AI Chat with one-tap copyable code cards, and a system-wide floating overlay assistant (`AiOverlayService`), powered by user-provided Google AI Studio keys (`gemini-flash-latest` with automatic fallback).
- **Zero-Barrier Instant Access:** Every signed-in user gets full access to all home, remote control, and chat capabilities immediately upon completing sign-in and permissions—without activation keys or waiting screens.

### Developer Design Philosophy

**Rubaeat Islam Raja (Arup Raja)** designed vitRemote around five engineering pillars:

1. **Permanent Identity Stability:** Reinstalling the app or clearing storage on the same hardware restores the same permanent 9-digit device code and account binding cleanly.
2. **Real-Time Responsiveness:** All cloud state updates, device presence heartbeats, remote frame deliveries, chat threads, and call signaling channels use live Firestore snapshot listeners backed by coroutine flows.
3. **Resilient Background Execution:** Foreground services (`CloudRelayManager`, `CaptureService`, `AiOverlayService`, `RemoteService`, `RemoteNotificationListenerService`) coordinate cleanly with Android battery exemption settings.
4. **Zero-Trust Security Isolation:** Firestore security rules enforce strict ownership checks, participant isolation, 9-digit code verification, and encrypted local server vault records.
5. **Accessible Bilingual Experience:** Full support for Bengali and English interfaces, dynamic Light and Dark themes, minimum 48dp interactive touch targets, and TalkBack-friendly descriptions.

## 3. Core Capabilities

### 3.1 Global Remote Screen Streaming
- Uses Android `MediaProjection` via `ProjectionActivity` and `CaptureService` to capture live display buffers cleanly.
- Encodes optimized JPEG frames with sequence tracking (`seq`), aspect ratio dimensions (`width`, `height`), and full-shot refresh markers (`isFullShot`).
- Supports selectable stream quality (`360p` low-bandwidth, `480p` balanced, `720p` high-clarity) from the remote viewer toolbar.
- Displays live connection status, viewer latency indicators, and one-tap disconnect controls on both host and controller devices.

### 3.2 Interactive Accessibility Control
- Built on `RemoteService` extending Android's `AccessibilityService`.
- Dispatches multi-point gestures accurately scaled from viewer display coordinates to target screen coordinates.
- Executes system-wide actions including `GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK`, `GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME`, `GLOBAL_ACTION_RECENTS`, `GLOBAL_ACTION_NOTIFICATIONS`, `GLOBAL_ACTION_QUICK_SETTINGS`, `GLOBAL_ACTION_POWER_DIALOG`, `GLOBAL_ACTION_TAKE_SCREENSHOT`, and `GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN`.
- Supports remote text injection into focused input fields, Backspace deletion, Enter/Submit key simulation, and directional scrolling.

### 3.3 Virtual Screen & App Inventory
- Scans installed launchable packages on the host phone and publishes sanitized app metadata (`label`, `packageName`, `systemApp`) to the authorized cloud metadata slot.
- Allows remote controllers to pick any app and launch it either on the **Real Screen** or inside an isolated **Virtual Screen** container.
- Supports clean virtual display teardown (`A:vclose`) when ending background app sessions.

### 3.4 Hardware & Device Utilities
- **Find-Phone Ring Alert (`r:start` / `r:stop`):** Plays a loud alarm/ringtone stream even when the phone is misplaced nearby.
- **Camera Flashlight Toggle (`f:on` / `f:off` / `f:toggle`):** Controls the rear camera torch LED via Android `CameraManager`.
- **System Brightness Control (`B:<0-255>`):** Adjusts screen backlight intensity using `WRITE_SETTINGS`.
- **Two-Way Clipboard Sync (`k:<text>` / `K:pull`):** Reads the host device's latest clipboard entry or pushes text directly to the target device clipboard.
- **Screen Wake & Lock (`X:wake` / `X:lock`):** Wakes sleeping screens or locks the device when `DeviceAdminReceiver` / accessibility lock is enabled.
- **Audio Mute & Max Boost (`X:muteall` / `X:volmax`):** Silences media/ringer channels or maximizes alert volume in emergencies.

### 3.5 Messenger Chat & Audio/Video Calls
- Dedicated **Chat** bottom navigation tab lists recent conversations, unread activity, and quick launch into active device threads.
- Supports real-time text messaging, Photo Picker gallery image uploads (encoded safely within Firestore limits), and automatic call log entries (`AUDIO_CALL`, `VIDEO_CALL`).
- Supports **Audio Calls** and **Video Calls** with ringing (`RINGING`), active (`ACCEPTED`), declined (`REJECTED`), and ended (`ENDED`) states.
- `CallMediaEngine` captures live PCM audio (`AudioRecord` / `AudioTrack`) and CameraX/Camera preview frames to stream real-time voice and video packets over Firestore subcollections isolated to call participants.

### 3.6 6-Button AI Voice & Chat Assistant
1. **Master AI System Switch:** Enables/disables all AI engines and validates Google AI Studio API key readiness.
2. **Virtual Screen AI Mode:** Allows voice commands targeted at background virtual screen operations.
3. **Remote Screen AI Mode:** Analyzes the currently viewed remote screen and translates spoken instructions into remote taps, swipes, and text commands.
4. **Own Device Voice AI Mode:** Captures spoken commands on the local device, captures current screen UI context, queries Gemini (`GeminiAssistantClient`), and executes concrete UI actions via `DeviceActionExecutor` and spoken feedback via `TextToSpeech`.
5. **AI Chat Workspace (`AiChatScreen`):** Multi-turn conversational AI assistant featuring syntax-highlighted/copyable code cards, prompt presets, and clear history controls.
6. **Floating AI Overlay (`AiOverlayService`):** Places a draggable floating launch badge over any app so users can trigger voice AI anywhere on Android.

## 5. Detailed Component Reference

### 5.1 `MainActivity.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Primary Activity & App Root Orchestrator

- Enables edge-to-edge rendering via `enableEdgeToEdge()` and dynamically updates light/dark system status and navigation bars whenever `isDarkTheme` toggles.
- Observes Firebase authentication state changes, executes `CloudViewModel.verifyDeviceBinding()` on sign-in, and guards access against blocked users, blocked hardware IDs, or global server maintenance mode.
- Manages the multi-step onboarding pipeline (`DeviceCheckingStepScreen` -> `DeveloperIntroStepScreen` -> `PermissionsAllowStepScreen` -> `GeminiApiKeyStepScreen`) and persists completion state.
- Hosts the three primary navigation tabs (`VitRemoteHostTab`, `RemoteDevicesTab`, `ChatTabScreen`) along with modal overlays (`HowToUseDialog`, `TelegramSupportDialog`, `ServerVaultLockDialog`, `DeveloperCreditDialog`, `AiChatScreen`, `IncomingCallDialog`, `ActiveCallScreen`).

### 5.2 `MainScreen.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Host Device Dashboard & Quick Action Controls

- Renders the top header displaying app identity, signed-in Google email, and compact action triggers (`How to Use`, `Dark/Light Theme` toggle, `Language` dropdown for Bengali/English, `Telegram Support`, and `Sign Out`).
- Displays real-time cloud connection status pill, permanent 9-digit device code (`XXX-XXX-XXX`) with one-tap Copy and Share actions, editable device alias dialog, and one-tap `Connect to Other Device` button.
- Exposes interactive readiness cards for Cloud Relay Switch, Screen Capture Consent, Accessibility Service, Notification Access, Display Overlay, Contacts, Battery Optimization, and System Write Settings.
- Provides the 6-Button AI Control Panel with switches for Master AI, Virtual Screen AI, Remote Screen AI, Own Device Voice AI, AI Chat launcher, Floating Overlay toggle, and API key management.

### 5.3 `Prefs.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Local Configuration & Device Identity Store

- Generates and persists a cryptographically random, collision-resistant 9-digit permanent `deviceCode` and unique `deviceId` anchored in `SharedPreferences`.
- Stores user-selected `isDarkTheme` (`Boolean`) and `appLanguage` (`bn` or `en`), defaulting cleanly to Bengali (`LANG_BN`) while supporting instant runtime switching.
- Migrates legacy Gemini model preferences automatically to `gemini-flash-latest` and validates Google AI Studio API keys (`AIza...` and `AQ...` formats).
- Tracks single-device onboarding state, custom device alias, and preferred stream quality without imposing any activation-code or verification gating.

### 5.4 `DeviceInfo.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Hardware Telemetry Collector

- Reads live Android battery level, charging state, and thermal readings via `BatteryManager` and `ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED` sticky intents.
- Queries RAM utilization (`ActivityManager.MemoryInfo`) and internal storage free/total bytes (`StatFs`) formatted in megabytes for cloud device snapshots.
- Captures real physical display dimensions (`WindowMetrics` on API 30+, `DisplayMetrics` fallback) and device manufacturer/model metadata.

### 5.5 `CaptureService.kt & ProjectionActivity.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Foreground MediaProjection Capture Pipeline

- `ProjectionActivity` launches a transparent system activity to obtain `MediaProjectionManager.createScreenCaptureIntent()` permission without disrupting Compose navigation.
- `CaptureService` runs as a `mediaProjection` foreground service, configures a `VirtualDisplay` + `ImageReader`, downscales frames safely to target quality (`360`/`480`/`720`), compresses JPEG bytes, and invokes callbacks for `CloudRelayManager`.
- Gracefully handles orientation changes, paused screen updates, and clean shutdown when screen sharing stops.

### 5.6 `RemoteService.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** AccessibilityService Gesture & UI Engine

- Injects single-tap, long-press, swipe, and multi-segment gesture paths using `AccessibilityService.dispatchGesture()`.
- Executes global navigation commands (`Back`, `Home`, `Recents`, `Notifications`, `Quick Settings`, `Power`, `Lock Screen`, `Take Screenshot`).
- Reads live foreground package/window metadata and updates device foreground telemetry (`foregroundPackage`, `foregroundLabel`, `foregroundChangedAtMs`).
- Inspects active `AccessibilityNodeInfo` hierarchies for AI voice automation (`DeviceActionExecutor`) and performs remote text insertion via `ACTION_SET_TEXT`.

### 5.7 `RemoteNotificationListenerService.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Live Notification Mirroring Service

- Monitors active status bar notifications using Android's `NotificationListenerService` API.
- Sanitizes notification metadata (`key`, `packageName`, `appLabel`, `title`, `text`, `postedAtMs`, `ongoing`) and exposes live updates to `CloudRelayManager`.
- Syncs notification snapshots to the owner-accessible `devices/{deviceId}/meta/notifications` Firestore document upon remote request or state updates.

### 5.8 `CloudRelayManager.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Foreground Cloud Sync & Remote Command Executor

- Maintains online presence in `devices/{deviceId}`, publishes hardware telemetry, and updates `viewerActive` / `captureMode` flags.
- Listens to `devices/{deviceId}/commands` in real time, validates command payload integrity, executes hardware/UI/system/virtual-display actions, and marks commands `done` or `error`.
- Coordinates with `CaptureService` to stream screen frames to `devices/{deviceId}/frames/live` and virtual screen frames to `devices/{deviceId}/frames/virtual`.
- Publishes installed launchable application inventories (`devices/{deviceId}/meta/apps`) and active notifications (`devices/{deviceId}/meta/notifications`) safely.

### 5.9 `CloudRepository.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Firebase Firestore & Auth Data Repository

- Implements atomic single-account device binding (`deviceBindings/{deviceId}`), permanent 9-digit code registry (`deviceCodes/{code}`), and user directory syncing (`users/{uid}`).
- Enforces real-time observers for global maintenance notices, account blocks, hardware blocks, device heartbeats, saved device bookmarks, chats, and incoming calls.
- Provides zero-trust query paths for cross-user remote control authorized strictly by the target device's 9-digit `deviceCode`.
- Translates Firebase exceptions through `FirestoreErrorHandler` into clear user-facing diagnostics.

### 5.10 `CloudViewModel.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Central Reactive State & Session Coordinator

- Exposes immutable `StateFlow` streams for authentication, device binding, saved devices, remote viewer sessions, messenger threads, active calls, theme, and language.
- Coordinates end-to-end remote connection workflows: resolving a 9-digit code, verifying device online status, sending commands, subscribing to live/virtual frames, and tracking RTT latency.
- Manages in-app audio/video call setup, incoming call ringing state, participant media streams, and clean resource teardown.

### 5.11 `RemoteControllerScreen.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Interactive Remote Screen & Virtual Display UI

- Renders an interactive touch canvas displaying real or virtual device frames with coordinate mapping for taps, long-presses, and directional swipes.
- Includes a comprehensive quick-control bar: Quality selector (`360p`/`480p`/`720p`), Installed Apps launcher sheet, Live Notifications viewer sheet, Brightness slider, Flashlight toggle, Ring toggle, Clipboard sync dialog, Keyboard input bar, and Remote Voice AI trigger.
- Supports toggling between Real Screen and isolated Virtual Screen sessions seamlessly.

### 5.12 `ChatScreen.kt & CallMediaEngine.kt` (`com.example`)

**Responsibility:** Messenger Chat & Real-Time Audio/Video Calling

- Provides participant-scoped messaging threads supporting text, Photo Picker image sharing, and system call summary cards.
- `CallMediaEngine` manages Android microphone `AudioRecord`, speaker/earpiece `AudioTrack`, and camera frame encoding/decoding with mute and camera-flip controls.
- Renders full-screen `ActiveCallScreen` and high-priority `IncomingCallDialog` overlays with accept/decline/end controls.

### 5.13 `ai/ Package (4 Files)` (`com.example.ai`)

**Responsibility:** AI Voice Engine, Overlay, Gemini Client & Action Executor

- `GeminiAssistantClient` communicates with Gemini models (`gemini-flash-latest`), parses structured JSON screen plans (`AiScreenPlan`), and retries transient errors (`503`/`429`) automatically.
- `VoiceAssistantController` coordinates Android `SpeechRecognizer` listening, TTS confirmation prompts, and safety checks against master AI switches.
- `DeviceActionExecutor` maps high-level AI instructions (`tap`, `type`, `scroll`, `back`, `home`, `launchApp`, `callContact`) onto live UI trees.

## 6. Permanent 9-Digit Connection & Binding Lifecycle

vitRemote eliminates ephemeral pairing tokens and changing room IDs by binding each physical device to a permanent 9-digit identifier:

1. **Initial Generation:** On first launch, `Prefs` generates a unique `deviceId` (`dev_<uuid>`) and a random 9-digit `deviceCode` (`100000000`–`999999999`).
2. **Google Sign-In:** The user authenticates via Jetpack `CredentialManager` (`GetSignInWithGoogleOption`), returning a verified Firebase `uid` and `email`.
3. **Atomic Device Binding Verification:**
   - `CloudRepository.verifyAndBindDevice()` checks `deviceBindings/{deviceId}`.
   - If unbound, it atomically binds `deviceId` to `ownerUid` and registers `deviceCodes/{deviceCode}` -> `{ deviceId, ownerUid }`.
   - If already bound to the same `ownerUid`, it restores the persisted `deviceCode` cleanly even if the app was uninstalled and reinstalled.
   - If bound to a different Google account, `DeviceLockedToAccountScreen` informs the user which account owns the device to prevent unauthorized hijacking.
4. **Cloud Device Registration:** Once bound, the device document at `devices/{deviceId}` syncs online presence, model specs, battery/RAM/storage telemetry, and `cloudEnabled` state.
5. **Cross-Device Connection:** Any remote controller user who enters the 9-digit code looks up `deviceCodes/{code}`, reads `devices/{deviceId}` with matching `deviceCode`, and opens a live session if `cloudEnabled == true`.

```text
[Sign In with Google]
        │
        ▼
[Check deviceBindings/{deviceId}]
   ├── Unbound ──────────────▶ Create Binding + Register deviceCodes/{code}
   ├── Matches Current UID ──▶ Restore Permanent 9-Digit Code ──▶ Home Dashboard
   └── Owned by Other UID ───▶ Show Account Lock Screen
```

## 7. Remote Control Command Protocol Specification

Remote actions are transmitted asynchronously via `devices/{deviceId}/commands/{commandId}`. Every command document includes `senderUid`, `senderDeviceId`, `pin` (the exact 9-digit target `deviceCode`), `payload`, and lifecycle `status` (`pending` -> `done` | `error`).

### 7.1 Pointer, Touch & Gesture Payloads

| Command Prefix | Syntax Example | Description | Target Handler |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `t:` | `t:540,1180` | Single tap at normalized/pixel coordinates `(x, y)` | `RemoteService` |
| `l:` | `l:540,1180` | Long press (`650ms`) at coordinates `(x, y)` | `RemoteService` |
| `s:` | `s:540,1600,540,500,320` | Custom swipe path from `(x1, y1)` to `(x2, y2)` over `durationMs` | `RemoteService` |
| `g:up` | `g:up` | Scroll/swipe upward across viewport | `RemoteService` |
| `g:down` | `g:down` | Scroll/swipe downward across viewport | `RemoteService` |
| `g:left` | `g:left` | Swipe left (previous page / carousel slide) | `RemoteService` |
| `g:right` | `g:right` | Swipe right (next page / carousel slide) | `RemoteService` |

### 7.2 Global Android Navigation Payloads

| Payload | Action Executed | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `a:back` | System Back button | Equivalent to hardware/gesture Back |
| `a:home` | System Home button | Returns foreground to launcher |
| `a:recents` | Recent Apps switcher | Opens Android task overview |
| `a:notif` | Pull Notification Shade | Expands status bar notifications |
| `a:qs` | Pull Quick Settings | Expands system toggles (Wi-Fi, Data, Torch) |
| `a:power` | Open Power Menu | Displays Android power/restart options |
| `a:allapps` | Open App Drawer | Triggers global launcher all-apps shortcut |

### 7.3 Text Input & Clipboard Payloads

| Payload | Action Executed | Target Handler |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `i:<text>` | Injects UTF-8 text into focused editable node | `RemoteService` |
| `b` | Sends Backspace / deletes trailing character | `RemoteService` |
| `e` | Sends Enter / IME Submit action | `RemoteService` |
| `k:<text>` | Writes `<text>` directly to target device clipboard | `CloudRelayManager` |
| `K:pull` | Reads current target clipboard and updates `devices/{deviceId}.clipboardText` | `CloudRelayManager` |

### 7.4 Hardware, Screen & Telemetry Payloads

| Payload | Action Executed | Requirement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `c` | Request immediate full-frame screen capture (`isFullShot = true`) | MediaProjection active |
| `P` | Smart power key toggle (Wake if off, Lock if active) | Accessibility / Admin |
| `r:start` | Start high-volume Find-Phone ring alert | Foreground Relay active |
| `r:stop` | Stop active Find-Phone ring alert | Foreground Relay active |
| `f:on` | Turn camera flashlight LED ON | Rear camera flash hardware |
| `f:off` | Turn camera flashlight LED OFF | Rear camera flash hardware |
| `f:toggle` | Toggle current camera flashlight state | Rear camera flash hardware |
| `B:<0-255>` | Set screen brightness to numeric level (`0` to `255`) | `WRITE_SETTINGS` granted |
| `X:lock` | Lock target screen immediately | Accessibility / Admin |
| `X:wake` | Wake sleeping screen with WakeLock pulse | Standard |
| `X:sync` | Sync battery, RAM, storage, apps, and notifications | Relay active |
| `X:sysinfo` | Refresh hardware metrics snapshot only | Relay active |
| `X:muteall` | Mute ringer, media, and alarm audio streams | AudioManager |
| `X:volmax` | Boost ringer/alert audio streams to maximum | AudioManager |
| `X:killapp` | Minimize active app back to Home screen | Accessibility active |
| `X:split` | Toggle Android split-screen mode | Accessibility API 24+ |
| `X:toast:<msg>` | Display short toast overlay on target screen | Relay active |
| `X:popup:<msg>` | Display high-priority notification/popup alert | Notifications enabled |
| `X:tts:<speech>` | Speak text aloud on target device speaker | `TextToSpeech` engine |
| `X:media:playpause` | Dispatch `KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE` media toggle | AudioManager |

### 7.5 Virtual Screen & Metadata Payloads

| Payload | Action Executed | Output Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `A:list` | Collect all installed launchable packages | `devices/{deviceId}/meta/apps` |
| `A:launch:<pkg>` | Launch `<pkg>` directly on main Real Screen | Target foreground |
| `A:vlaunch:<pkg>` | Launch `<pkg>` inside Virtual Screen display | `devices/{deviceId}/frames/virtual` |
| `A:vclose` | Close active Virtual Screen display session | Virtual display released |
| `N:list` | Sync all active notifications from listener | `devices/{deviceId}/meta/notifications` |

## 8. Virtual Screen & Isolated App Execution

vitRemote provides an isolated Virtual Screen workflow so remote support sessions can open and inspect apps cleanly without interrupting whatever the host user is currently doing:

- **App Inventory Discovery:** Running `A:list` enumerates installed launchable packages on the host phone, separates user apps from system apps, and uploads the directory to `devices/{deviceId}/meta/apps`.
- **Dual Launch Targets:** From the Apps sheet inside `RemoteControllerScreen`, the controller chooses either **Real Screen** (launches via standard `PackageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage`) or **Virtual Screen** (`A:vlaunch:<packageName>`).
- **Dedicated Frame Stream:** Virtual display output streams to `devices/{deviceId}/frames/virtual`, while `virtualScreenActive`, `virtualScreenPackage`, and `virtualScreenStatus` are tracked live on the device document.
- **Instant Switch & Teardown:** Tapping between Real and Virtual view inside the controller switches active frame rendering without dropping the remote connection, and `A:vclose` releases virtual display surfaces cleanly.

---

## 9. Real-Time Hardware Telemetry & Device Utilities

Every connected device continuously reports authentic hardware telemetry sourced directly from Android OS APIs:

- **Battery Monitoring:** Percentage (`0–100`), AC/USB/wireless charging status (`charging`), and tenths-of-degree temperature (`batteryTempTenths`).
- **Memory & Storage Metrics:** Live `ramUsedMb`, `ramTotalMb`, `storageUsedMb`, and `storageTotalMb` computed from `ActivityManager` and `StatFs`.
- **Foreground Context:** Active `foregroundPackage`, human-readable `foregroundLabel`, and `foregroundChangedAtMs` timestamp updated by `RemoteService`.
- **Hardware Controls:** Remote brightness (`0–255`), rear LED torch toggle, and find-phone alarm ringtone control directly integrated into the controller's top action bar.

---

## 10. In-App Messenger Chat & Live Audio/Video Calling

vitRemote includes a built-in participant-isolated messaging and real-time calling module (`ChatScreen.kt` & `CallMediaEngine.kt`):

### 10.1 Chat Threads & Attachments
- Threads live at `chats/{chatId}` with deterministic sorted participant UIDs (`participants: [uidA, uidB]`) and per-participant unread/typing metadata.
- Messages are immutable once created (`allow update, delete: if false;` in `firestore.rules`), ensuring integrity of chat history and call logs (`TEXT`, `IMAGE`, `AUDIO_CALL`, `VIDEO_CALL`).
- Photo attachments use Android's zero-permission **Photo Picker** (`ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia`), resized and compressed safely before transmission so no `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` or storage permission is ever required.

### 10.2 Audio & Video Call Architecture
- Signaling documents live at `chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}` tracking `callerUid`, `calleeUid`, `callType` (`AUDIO` or `VIDEO`), and `status` (`RINGING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED`, `ENDED`).
- Media packet documents live at `chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}/streams/{participantUid}`, strictly guarded in Firestore rules so each participant can write only their own stream document while reading their peer's stream.
- `CallMediaEngine` captures live microphone PCM audio via `AudioRecord`, plays incoming audio via `AudioTrack`, and streams camera frames when video mode is enabled.

## 11. 6-Button AI Voice, Screen Automation & Chat System

vitRemote offers a modular 6-button AI assistant suite that works purely with the user's own optional Google AI Studio API key:

1. **Button 1 — Master AI System Switch:** Controls overall AI readiness and verifies whether a valid `AIza...` or `AQ...` key is saved in `Prefs`.
2. **Button 2 — Virtual Screen AI:** Enables voice-driven automation focused on Virtual Screen workflows.
3. **Button 3 — Remote Screen AI:** Enables spoken commands targeting the currently connected remote device.
4. **Button 4 — Own Device Voice AI:** Activates on-device `SpeechRecognizer` listening, captures visible UI node context via `RemoteService`, calls `GeminiAssistantClient`, and performs taps/scrolls/launches via `DeviceActionExecutor`.
5. **Button 5 — AI Chat Workspace:** Opens `AiChatScreen` with multi-turn Gemini conversation history, Markdown-formatted code blocks, and one-tap code copying.
6. **Button 6 — Floating Overlay Logo:** Starts `AiOverlayService` to keep an accessible floating AI button across other apps.

### Gemini API Resilience (`GeminiAssistantClient`)
- Prioritizes `gemini-flash-latest` and automatically migrates legacy deprecated model identifiers stored in preferences.
- Automatically detects transient `503 Service Unavailable` ("high demand") and `429 Rate Limit` responses and applies bounded retry/backoff logic.
- Extracts suggested replacement model names cleanly if an upstream endpoint reports model deprecation.

---

## 12. Security Architecture, Vault & Zero-Trust Firestore Rules

vitRemote enforces multi-layered security across authentication, client verification, encrypted assets, and server-side Cloud Firestore rules (`firestore.rules`):

1. **Google Identity Binding:** All Firebase access requires a verified `request.auth.uid`. Anonymous authentication is disabled.
2. **Single-Account Device Lock:** `deviceBindings/{deviceId}` is write-once (`allow update, delete: if false` for regular users), preventing another Google account from stealing an already-bound device's permanent code.
3. **Non-Enumerable Code Lookup:** `deviceCodes/{code}` allows single-document `get` queries only (`allow list: if false`), blocking bulk enumeration of all 9-digit codes.
4. **Authorized Remote Sessions:** Reading device telemetry, live frames, and app/notification metadata is allowed exclusively for the device owner or a verified viewer who supplied the matching 9-digit `deviceCode` while `cloudEnabled == true`.
5. **Chat & Call Isolation:** Only the two listed chat participants can read or write thread messages, call signaling documents, and call media streams.
6. **Encrypted Local Server Vault (`SecureServerVault`):** Sensitive vault configuration inside `app/src/main/assets/server_vault_locked.zip` is encrypted and guarded by SHA-256 password verification.

---

## 13. Firestore Database Schema Reference

| Collection Path | Document ID | Primary Purpose | Access Model |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/users/{userId}` | Firebase `uid` | User profile, device model, OS version, `lastDeviceId`, `lastDeviceCode`, block status | Owner read/write (immutable `blocked`/`role`) |
| `/deviceBindings/{deviceId}` | Device UUID | Enforces one Google account per physical device and stores permanent `deviceCode` | Owner create, public-signed get |
| `/deviceCodes/{code}` | 9-digit code | Direct code-to-`deviceId` resolution without collection listing | Signed-in single `get` only |
| `/devices/{deviceId}` | Device UUID | Live online state, battery/RAM/storage, `cloudEnabled`, `viewerActive`, active foreground app | Owner or matching-code viewer |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/frames/{frameId}` | `live` or `virtual` | Latest compressed screen JPEG base64 frame + `seq` + `width` + `height` | Owner write; owner or active viewer read |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/meta/{metaId}` | `apps` or `notifications` | Installed app list and active notification mirror snapshots | Owner write; owner or active viewer read |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/commands/{cmdId}` | Auto ID | Remote control command queue (`pin`, `payload`, `status`) | Matching 9-digit code create; owner update |
| `/users/{userId}/savedDevices/{devId}` | Target `deviceId` | Saved quick-reconnect remote bookmarks with custom aliases & favorites | Strictly owner-only |
| `/chats/{chatId}` | Sorted `uidA_uidB` | Messenger thread metadata, participants, last message & incoming call indicator | Strictly thread participants |
| `/chats/{chatId}/messages/{msgId}` | Auto ID | Immutable text, photo, and call log messages | Strictly thread participants (create-only) |
| `/chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}` | Auto ID | Audio/Video call state machine (`RINGING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED`, `ENDED`) | Strictly call participants |
| `/chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}/streams/{uid}` | Participant `uid` | Live audio/video media stream packets for active calls | Owner stream write; peer stream read |
| `/blockedDevices/{deviceId}` | Device UUID | Hardware-level device block status and block notice reason | Signed-in read; server/admin write |
| `/appConfig/global` | `global` | Global server online/maintenance switch, notice banner, and minimum app version | Signed-in read; server/admin write |

## 15. Android Manifest Permissions & Google Play Compliance

vitRemote strictly follows **Google Play Developer Program** least-privilege guidelines:

- **Zero Broad Storage Permissions:** Does **not** declare `READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`, `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`, `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES`, or `READ_MEDIA_VIDEO`. Photo sharing in Chat uses the official zero-permission Android Photo Picker (`PickVisualMedia`).
- **Explicit Foreground Service Types:** Declares exact Android 14+ foreground service types (`mediaProjection`, `dataSync`, `microphone`, `camera`) matching real active components.
- **No Dynamic Code Loading:** Does not download or execute external `.dex`, `.jar`, or `.so` code at runtime.
- **User-Controlled Consent:** Screen capture (`MediaProjection`), Accessibility, Notification Listener, Device Admin, and Display Overlay all require explicit Android system user consent dialogs.

1. **Local JVM & Robolectric Suite (`ExampleRobolectricTest.kt` & `ExampleUnitTest.kt`):**
   - Verifies app identity (`vitRemote`) and Telegram support constants (`@BDrubaeat22`).
   - Validates permanent 9-digit device code generation and `XXX-XXX-XXX` formatting.
   - Validates `Prefs` theme (`isDarkTheme`) and language (`LANG_BN` / `LANG_EN`) switching and fallback behavior.
   - Verifies `DeviceInfo` JSON telemetry serialization.
   - Verifies `GeminiAssistantClient` model prioritization (`gemini-flash-latest`), legacy migration, API key format acceptance (`AIza...`, `AQ...`), `503` transient retry classification, and replacement model parsing.
   - Verifies `VoiceAssistantController` master-switch safety guard.
   - Verifies `SecureServerVault` SHA-256 / AES encrypted asset verification and unlocking.
2. **Firestore Security Rules Suite (`firestore.test.js`):**
   - Validates strict owner isolation on `users`, `deviceBindings`, and `savedDevices`.
   - Verifies cross-user remote control succeeds strictly with matching 9-digit `deviceCode` and fails with wrong codes.
   - Verifies `deviceCodes` list blocking and single-doc get rules.
   - Verifies participant isolation on `chats`, `messages`, `calls`, and `streams`.
   - Verifies shadow-field rejection and global admin controls.

## 20. Comprehensive Troubleshooting Guide

Use this diagnostic reference to resolve setup, permission, connectivity, AI, or call issues cleanly.

### 20.1 Google Sign-In & Account Binding

| Symptom | Resolution Steps |
| :--- | :--- |
| Google Sign-In sheet closes immediately without signing in | Ensure Google Play Services is active on the device, network connectivity is available, and `default_web_client_id` matches the configured Firebase project OAuth 2.0 Web Client ID. |
| Device displays locked-to-another-account screen on launch | The physical hardware `deviceId` is already bound inside `deviceBindings/{deviceId}` to a previously used Google account. Sign in with that original bound Google email to restore the permanent 9-digit code. |
| Silent re-login fails after app data clear | Tap `Sign in with Google` manually once; Credential Manager refreshes the authorized credential token and automatically re-links the saved 9-digit code. |
| Network error shown during binding verification | Verify internet connectivity and ensure system time/date is set to automatic network time so Firebase TLS and token timestamps validate properly. |
| Account shows blocked notice screen | An authorized administrator placed an account or hardware block on this user or device ID. Contact support via Telegram `@BDrubaeat22` if assistance is needed. |
| Maintenance screen blocks entry with custom notice | The administrator temporarily switched the global system server off (`appConfig/global.maintenanceMode = true`). Wait until the server is turned back online. |
| Multiple accounts logged into the same phone | During Google Sign-In, select the exact Google account previously bound to that device ID for instant binding restoration. |
| OAuth developer error code 10 during sign-in | Register the signing keystore SHA-1 and SHA-256 fingerprints in the Firebase Console and regenerate `google-services.json`. |

### 20.2 Remote Screen Capture & Streaming

| Symptom | Resolution Steps |
| :--- | :--- |
| Remote viewer sees waiting spinner without live frames | Confirm the target device has enabled both **Cloud Relay Switch** and **Live Screen Capture (`MediaProjection`)** in the Host Home tab. |
| Screen sharing stops automatically after turning screen off | Android revokes or pauses `MediaProjection` when battery saver kills background services. Enable **Unrestricted Battery** in the onboarding checklist. |
| Captured image looks blurry on high-DPI tablets | Open the top quality selector in `RemoteControllerScreen` and switch stream quality from `360p` or `480p` to `720p`. |
| Live frames lag on slow 3G/4G networks | Switch stream quality to `360p` to reduce frame payload size and speed up Firestore synchronization. |
| Black frame appears inside banking or DRM video apps | Android OS enforces `FLAG_SECURE` hardware protection on sensitive banking/DRM screens, blocking `MediaProjection` pixel capture by platform design. |
| Projection consent dialog does not appear | Ensure notification permissions (`POST_NOTIFICATIONS`) are granted so `CaptureService` can promote cleanly to a foreground `mediaProjection` service. |
| Remote viewer shows Device Offline badge | Confirm the host phone has active mobile data or Wi-Fi and `CloudRelayManager` is running in the notification tray. |
| Screen dimensions appear rotated after switching orientation | Tap the Force Full-Screen Sync (`c`) button inside the controller toolbar to refresh frame aspect metrics. |

### 20.3 Accessibility & Remote Touch Control

| Symptom | Resolution Steps |
| :--- | :--- |
| Remote screen displays live image but taps do nothing | Open Android Settings -> Accessibility -> Installed Apps -> Enable **vitRemote** (`RemoteService`). |
| Remote gestures feel slightly offset from visible buttons | Wait 1–2 seconds after rotating the host screen or tap `Refresh Frame` (`c`) so `screenWidth` and `screenHeight` sync cleanly. |
| Text injection (`i:<text>`) does not type into field | Tap directly on the target input box on the remote screen first so the Android input node receives accessibility focus before sending text. |
| Accessibility service turns off automatically after reboot | Check manufacturer battery/autostart managers (Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo/Samsung Sleeping Apps) and allow vitRemote background autostart + unrestricted battery. |
| System Lock command (`X:lock`) asks for permission on older Android | On Android 8.x, enable the optional Device Admin receiver (`AdminReceiver`) when prompted, or use Android 9+ native `GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN`. |
| Split screen (`X:split`) does not open on certain launchers | Verify the currently focused app supports multi-window mode (`resizeableActivity=true`) in Android. |
| Remote Back or Home key delayed by 1–2 seconds | High network latency can queue commands momentarily; inspect the live ping indicator in the remote controller header. |
| Notification panel fails to open via `a:notif` | Verify `RemoteService` accessibility status is green on the host home dashboard. |

### 20.4 Virtual Screen & Installed App Launching

| Symptom | Resolution Steps |
| :--- | :--- |
| Installed apps sheet shows empty list | Tap Refresh inside the Apps dialog to dispatch `A:list`, and ensure the host phone is online. |
| App opens on host phone screen instead of background virtual display | Ensure you tapped the **Virtual Screen** launch option (`A:vlaunch:`) rather than **Real Screen** (`A:launch:`). |
| Some third-party apps refuse to render inside virtual displays | Certain games or protected apps restrict rendering on secondary virtual displays; use **Real Screen** mode for those apps. |
| Virtual display stays active after leaving controller | Tap **Close Virtual Screen** (`A:vclose`) inside the controller bar to release the background virtual display immediately. |
| App search filter misses recently installed apps | Re-run `A:list` refresh to re-scan `PackageManager` and publish the updated app catalog. |

### 20.5 Notifications, Torch, Ring & Brightness

| Symptom | Resolution Steps |
| :--- | :--- |
| Remote Notifications tab says Notification Listener disabled | Tap **Notification Access** on the Host Home screen and toggle **vitRemote** ON inside Android Notification Access settings. |
| Flashlight toggle fails to turn on rear LED | Confirm the device has a rear camera flash unit and is not locked by another active camera app. |
| Find-Phone Ring alert plays quietly | Tap `Vol Max` (`X:volmax`) before starting `Ring` (`r:start`) if the host device ringer was muted. |
| Brightness slider does not change target display brightness | Grant **Modify System Settings (`WRITE_SETTINGS`)** on the host phone from the Host Home checklist or onboarding flow. |
| Clipboard pull returns empty text | On Android 10+, clipboard reads work reliably when vitRemote is active in foreground or accessibility context; retry `K:pull` after copying text. |

### 20.6 Messenger Chat & Audio/Video Calls

| Symptom | Resolution Steps |
| :--- | :--- |
| Messages do not appear immediately in Chat tab | Check active internet connectivity on both sender and receiver devices and verify both users are signed in. |
| Photo attachment button fails to open gallery | Android Photo Picker (`PickVisualMedia`) handles media safely without storage permissions; update Google Play Services if picker fails on older devices. |
| Other party cannot hear audio during Audio/Video Call | Confirm `RECORD_AUDIO` (Microphone) permission is granted on the caller/callee devices and the mute button is not toggled on. |
| Video call shows audio only without camera feed | Grant `CAMERA` permission on the host phone and enable the camera toggle inside `ActiveCallScreen`. |
| Incoming call dialog does not ring when screen is off | Ensure `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` permission is enabled and battery optimization is set to Unrestricted. |
| Audio echo occurs when two phones test calls in the same room | Move devices apart or lower speaker volume during proximity testing to prevent acoustic feedback. |

### 20.7 AI Voice, Chat & Floating Overlay

| Symptom | Resolution Steps |
| :--- | :--- |
| AI switches reject activation with missing API key prompt | Open API Key Settings from Onboarding or Home Screen and enter a valid Google AI Studio key (`AIza...`). |
| Gemini responds with temporary busy message (503 / 429) | The AI client automatically retries transient `503` high-demand errors; wait a few seconds and retry if quota is temporarily throttled. |
| Speech recognition fails to capture voice command | Confirm Microphone (`RECORD_AUDIO`) permission is granted and Google Speech Services / Voice Typing is enabled on the device. |
| Floating AI overlay button disappears when leaving app | Grant **Display over other apps (`SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW`)** in Android Special App Access settings. |
| Voice AI opens wrong app when spoken name is ambiguous | Speak the full English or Bengali app name clearly as shown in the Android launcher. |
| AI Chat code snippet formatting looks clipped on narrow screens | Use the horizontal scroll or tap the dedicated **Copy Code** button directly on the code card. |

### 20.8 Extended System & Build Diagnostics

| Symptom | Subsystem | Recommended Fix |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Battery optimization kills background CloudRelayManager after 15 minutes | Battery & Power | Open App Info -> Battery -> select Unrestricted, and lock vitRemote in recent apps on OEM skins like MIUI/ColorOS/OneUI. |
| Firestore PERMISSION_DENIED error when opening saved remote device | Cloud Rules | Confirm the remote target device has `cloudEnabled = true` and the 9-digit `deviceCode` stored in `savedDevices` still matches the target device. |
| Language does not update inside system notifications | Localization | System notification titles reflect the active language stored at service startup; toggle Cloud Relay off and on after changing language. |
| Dark mode status bar icons look unreadable on older Android 8.0 | Theming | Ensure `isDarkTheme` is toggled cleanly through the Home top strip so `SystemBarStyle` refreshes edge-to-edge bar contrast. |
| APK installation blocked by Play Protect / Unknown Sources | Deployment | Open Android Settings -> Apps -> Special access -> Install unknown apps -> allow your browser or file manager. |
| App fails to compile in Android Studio due to missing google-services.json | Build | Verify `app/google-services.json` exists for your Firebase project and Google Sign-In is enabled under Firebase Authentication. |
| Robolectric unit test fails in Linux CI container without .m2 cache | Testing | Ensure Maven local repository cache is linked cleanly and run `gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.example.ExampleRobolectricTest`. |
| CloudRepositoryRuleTest hangs without Firestore emulator | Testing | Start the Firebase Firestore Emulator on `127.0.0.1:8085` before executing emulator-dependent rules tests. |

## 21. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1. What is vitRemote used for?**  
vitRemote is an Android remote support, live screen sharing, virtual app display, device utilities, messenger chat, audio/video calling, and AI voice automation platform built by Rubaeat Islam Raja (Arup Raja).

**Q2. Does vitRemote require both phones to be on the same Wi-Fi network?**  
No. vitRemote operates entirely through Cloud Firestore relay infrastructure, allowing connections across separate Wi-Fi, 4G, and 5G networks worldwide.

**Q3. Does the 9-digit device code expire or change?**  
No. Each device receives a permanent 9-digit connection code anchored to its hardware `deviceId` and bound Google account.

**Q4. Is any activation code or admin confirmation required to unlock vitRemote?**  
No. Once you sign in with Google and finish the permission checklist, every feature on the Home, Remote Control, and Chat tabs is unlocked immediately.

**Q5. Can I use vitRemote without entering a Google AI Studio API key?**  
Yes. Entering an AI key is completely optional. Remote screen control, virtual display, hardware utilities, messenger chat, and audio/video calls all work without an AI key.

**Q6. How do I enable AI Voice and AI Chat features?**  
Enter your personal Google AI Studio key (`AIza...`) during onboarding or tap the API key settings card on the Home screen.

**Q7. Which Gemini model does vitRemote use?**  
vitRemote defaults to `gemini-flash-latest` and automatically migrates deprecated model names while retrying transient `503` demand spikes.

**Q8. What is the difference between Real Screen and Virtual Screen?**  
Real Screen launches and controls apps directly on the host phone's visible display. Virtual Screen runs apps in an isolated virtual display surface without interrupting the host phone's active screen.

**Q9. Why does vitRemote ask for Accessibility Service permission?**  
Android requires AccessibilityService (`RemoteService`) to inject remote touch taps, swipes, Back/Home navigation, and AI voice screen actions.

**Q10. Why does vitRemote ask for Notification Access?**  
Android requires `NotificationListenerService` solely to mirror active notifications to your authorized remote controller when requested.

**Q11. Does vitRemote request broad storage or gallery permissions?**  
No. Messenger photo attachments use Android's zero-permission Photo Picker (`PickVisualMedia`), protecting user privacy and Play Policy compliance.

**Q12. How do I switch between Bengali and English?**  
Tap the Language selector button (`বাংলা` / `English`) at the top of the Home screen to switch the entire interface immediately.

**Q13. How do I enable Dark Theme?**  
Tap the Dark/Light Theme toggle button in the top quick-action bar on the Home screen.

**Q14. What should I do if I see a device lock screen for another Google account?**  
Sign in with the Google account originally bound to that physical device, as vitRemote enforces single-account hardware binding to protect device ownership.

**Q15. Who developed vitRemote and how can I contact support?**  
vitRemote was developed by Rubaeat Islam Raja (Arup Raja). Official support is available on Telegram via `@BDrubaeat22`.

**Q16. What Android versions are supported?**  
vitRemote supports Android 8.0 Oreo (API 26) up through Android 16 (API 36).

**Q17. Can I turn off remote access temporarily without signing out?**  
Yes. Toggle the Cloud Relay switch (`cloudEnabled`) off on the Host Home screen to immediately block incoming remote viewing and command requests.

**Q18. Can I disconnect an active remote viewer immediately?**  
Yes. Tap the Disconnect Viewer button inside the active connection card on the Host Home screen at any time.

**Q19. What happens to chat messages and call logs?**  
Chat threads are isolated strictly to their two authenticated participants, and messages are immutable once sent.

**Q20. How is sensitive server configuration protected inside the APK?**  
Server vault metadata is stored inside `server_vault_locked.zip` protected by AES encryption and SHA-256 password verification inside `SecureServerVault`.

## 22. End-to-End Operational Scenarios

### Scenario A — Remote Family Phone Assistance Across Cities
1. User A signs into vitRemote on Phone A with Google, completes the 7-permission checklist, and leaves Cloud Relay and Screen Capture enabled.
2. User A copies or shares their permanent 9-digit code (for example, `482-915-730`).
3. User B signs into vitRemote on Phone B, opens `Connect to Other Device`, enters `482915730`, and taps Connect.
4. Phone B resolves `deviceCodes/482915730` -> `devices/{deviceId}`, verifies `cloudEnabled == true`, sets `viewerActive = true`, and receives live frames.
5. User B taps, scrolls, types text, checks notifications, or enables Remote Screen AI voice control to help User A troubleshoot settings in real time.

### Scenario B — Locating a Misplaced Phone Silently Left on Vibrate
1. User opens vitRemote from a second paired phone and connects to the misplaced phone's saved device card.
2. User taps `Vol Max` (`X:volmax`) followed by `Ring` (`r:start`).
3. Even if the misplaced phone was previously muted or far away in another room, `CloudRelayManager` plays the high-volume ring alert until `r:stop` is tapped.

### Scenario C — Isolated Virtual App Check Without Interrupting Host User
1. While User A reads an article on Phone A, User B opens the Apps dialog in the remote controller.
2. User B selects **Virtual Screen** for a utility app (`A:vlaunch:<packageName>`).
3. `CloudRelayManager` spawns a virtual display container and streams frames exclusively to `frames/virtual`, leaving User A's screen completely undisturbed.

### Scenario D — Hands-Free Own-Device Voice Automation
1. User enables Master AI (`Button 1`), Own Device Voice AI (`Button 4`), and Floating Overlay (`Button 6`).
2. User taps the floating AI overlay badge from any screen and speaks a command such as "Open Settings" or "Tap Search".
3. `VoiceAssistantController` transcribes speech, `RemoteService` reads visible clickable nodes, `GeminiAssistantClient` generates a structured `AiScreenPlan`, and `DeviceActionExecutor` performs the action cleanly.

## 23. Technical Glossary

| Term | Definition |
| :--- | :--- |
| **9-Digit Device Code** | Permanent numeric identifier (`XXX-XXX-XXX`) bound to one physical device and Google UID for cloud remote pairing. |
| **AccessibilityService** | Android framework service (`RemoteService`) enabling authorized gesture dispatch, UI node reading, and global navigation actions. |
| **CloudRelayManager** | Foreground service inside vitRemote managing device online heartbeats, telemetry uploads, and incoming command execution. |
| **Credential Manager** | Jetpack authentication API (`GetSignInWithGoogleOption`) handling modern Google Sign-In tokens. |
| **Device Binding** | Write-once Firestore lock (`deviceBindings/{deviceId}`) guaranteeing one physical device maps to one authorized Google account. |
| **Foreground Service** | High-priority Android background execution component with a persistent status notification (`CaptureService`, `CloudRelayManager`, `AiOverlayService`). |
| **MediaProjection** | Android system API enabling user-consented screen capture into `ImageReader` buffers. |
| **NotificationListenerService** | Android system service (`RemoteNotificationListenerService`) reading active notifications after explicit user consent. |
| **SecureServerVault** | Encrypted local asset container verified via SHA-256 password hashing before revealing server metadata. |
| **Virtual Screen** | Secondary virtual display rendered off-screen (`frames/virtual`) allowing isolated remote app execution. |

### 24.2 Zero-Trust Firestore Security Matrix

| Path Pattern | Operation | Enforced Rule Contract |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/users/{userId}` | `get` | Allow authenticated user if `isOwner(userId)` or authorized admin. |
| `/users/{userId}` | `list` | Allow authorized admins only; deny enumeration by regular users. |
| `/users/{userId}` | `create` | Allow owner creation with validated `uid`, `email`, `lastDeviceId`, `lastDeviceCode`, `role = 'user'`, `blocked = false`. |
| `/users/{userId}` | `update` | Allow owner metadata updates while blocking self-modification of `blocked`, `blockReason`, `blockedBy`, or `role`. |
| `/users/{userId}` | `delete` | Allow authorized admins only. |
| `/deviceBindings/{deviceId}` | `get` | Allow any signed-in user for single-device ownership lookup. |
| `/deviceBindings/{deviceId}` | `list` | Allow authorized admins only. |
| `/deviceBindings/{deviceId}` | `create` | Allow signed-in owner creating immutable device-to-UID and 9-digit code mapping. |
| `/deviceBindings/{deviceId}` | `update, delete` | Allow authorized admins only; deny client tampering. |
| `/deviceCodes/{code}` | `get` | Allow signed-in users when `code` matches 9-digit numeric pattern. |
| `/deviceCodes/{code}` | `list` | Strictly denied (`false`) to prevent brute-force code harvesting. |
| `/deviceCodes/{code}` | `create` | Allow device owner registering their permanent 9-digit code mapping. |
| `/deviceCodes/{code}` | `update, delete` | Allow authorized admins only. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}` | `get` | Allow owner, admin, or viewer authorized via matching `deviceCode` and `cloudEnabled == true`. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}` | `list` | Allow query only when filtered cleanly by `deviceCode` (`limit <= 5`) or owner/admin. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}` | `create, update` | Allow device owner updating telemetry, online state, and allowed session flags cleanly. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/frames/{frameId}` | `get` | Allow owner, admin, or active authorized remote viewer. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/frames/{frameId}` | `create, update` | Allow device owner streaming `live` or `virtual` JPEG buffers. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/meta/{metaId}` | `get` | Allow owner, admin, or active authorized remote viewer. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/meta/{metaId}` | `create, update` | Allow device owner publishing `apps` and `notifications` payloads. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/commands/{cmdId}` | `get, list` | Allow device owner, command sender, or authorized admin. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/commands/{cmdId}` | `create` | Allow signed-in user only when `pin == parentDevice.deviceCode` and `cloudEnabled == true`. |
| `/devices/{deviceId}/commands/{cmdId}` | `update` | Allow device owner transitioning `status` from `pending` to `done` or `error`. |
| `/users/{userId}/savedDevices/{devId}` | `get, list, write` | Allow strictly when `isOwner(userId)`. |
| `/chats/{chatId}` | `get, list` | Allow strictly when `request.auth.uid in resource.data.participants`. |
| `/chats/{chatId}` | `create, update` | Allow signed-in participant with bounded 2-UID participant array. |
| `/chats/{chatId}/messages/{msgId}` | `get, list` | Allow strictly to thread participants. |
| `/chats/{chatId}/messages/{msgId}` | `create` | Allow thread participant with matching `senderUid == request.auth.uid`. |
| `/chats/{chatId}/messages/{msgId}` | `update, delete` | Strictly denied (`false`) to preserve immutable message audit history. |
| `/chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}` | `get, list, create, update` | Allow strictly to call participants for real-time signaling. |
| `/chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}/streams/{uid}` | `get, list` | Allow strictly to call participants. |
| `/chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}/streams/{uid}` | `create, update` | Allow strictly when `isOwner(uid)` inside the call. |
| `/blockedDevices/{deviceId}` | `get` | Allow signed-in clients checking hardware block status. |
| `/blockedDevices/{deviceId}` | `create, update, delete` | Allow authorized admins only. |
| `/appConfig/{configId}` | `get` | Allow signed-in clients reading maintenance mode and global notices. |
| `/appConfig/{configId}` | `create, update` | Allow authorized admins only. |


### 24.3 Subsystem Engineering Specifications & Edge-Case Contracts

#### 24.3.1 Authentication & Identity Subsystem (`AuthScreen.kt` · `CredentialManager` · `SignInWithGoogle`)

- **SPEC-01.01:** Initializes `CredentialManager.create(context)` lazily within composable scope.
- **SPEC-01.02:** Attempts authorized silent sign-in on first frame using `GetGoogleIdOption` with `setFilterByAuthorizedAccounts(true)`.
- **SPEC-01.03:** Falls back gracefully to explicit interactive `GetSignInWithGoogleOption` bottom sheet upon user tap.
- **SPEC-01.04:** Extracts verified Google ID token via `GoogleIdTokenCredential.createFrom(credential.data)`.
- **SPEC-01.05:** Exchanges token cleanly with `FirebaseAuth.signInWithCredential(GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential(idToken, null))`.
- **SPEC-01.06:** Handles `GetCredentialCancellationException` silently without displaying false alarm error banners.
- **SPEC-01.07:** Clears credential state via `ClearCredentialStateRequest` on explicit user sign-out.
- **SPEC-01.08:** Verifies `auth.currentUser != null` prior to invoking `CloudViewModel.verifyDeviceBinding()`.

#### 24.3.2 Device Binding & Ownership Guard (`CloudRepository.kt` · `deviceBindings` · `AccountBindingState`)

- **SPEC-02.01:** Constructs deterministic hardware key from persisted `Prefs.deviceId` or generates UUID-backed identifier.
- **SPEC-02.02:** Queries `deviceBindings/{deviceId}` inside bounded network timeout (`withTimeout(10_000L)`).
- **SPEC-02.03:** Transitions `bindingState` across `Checking`, `Bound`, `LockedToOtherAccount`, and `Error` sealed states.
- **SPEC-02.04:** Ensures `deviceCodes/{code}` records owner UID, device ID, model string, and server timestamp atomically.
- **SPEC-02.05:** Synchronizes `users/{uid}` profile record with `lastDeviceId`, `lastDeviceCode`, `deviceModel`, `androidVersion`, and `appVersion`.
- **SPEC-02.06:** Detects account mismatch immediately and halts background relay startup when hardware belongs to another email.
- **SPEC-02.07:** Preserves original 9-digit `deviceCode` seamlessly across app updates and reinstalls.

#### 24.3.3 Cloud Relay Foreground Service (`CloudRelayManager.kt` · `devices` · `ForegroundRelay`)

- **SPEC-03.01:** Runs inside persistent `dataSync` foreground notification channel compatible with Android 8.0 through Android 16.
- **SPEC-03.02:** Maintains active snapshot listener on `devices/{deviceId}/commands` filtered cleanly for `pending` work.
- **SPEC-03.03:** Publishes fresh `DeviceInfo` telemetry pulses (`batteryLevel`, `charging`, `batteryTempTenths`, `ramUsedMb`, `ramTotalMb`, `storageUsedMb`, `storageTotalMb`).
- **SPEC-03.04:** Monitors `cloudEnabled` switches and automatically pauses remote frame uploads when disabled by the host.
- **SPEC-03.05:** Tracks active controller state (`viewerActive`, `viewerQuality`, `activeViewerUid`) in real time.
- **SPEC-03.06:** Executes hardware commands (`r:start`, `r:stop`, `f:on`, `f:off`, `f:toggle`, `B:<val>`, `X:muteall`, `X:volmax`, `X:vibrate`).
- **SPEC-03.07:** Routes accessibility UI commands (`t:`, `l:`, `s:`, `g:`, `a:`, `i:`, `b`, `e`, `X:lock`, `X:killapp`, `X:split`) to `RemoteService`.
- **SPEC-03.08:** Marks every command document atomically with `status = 'done'` or descriptive `errorMessage` on exception.

#### 24.3.4 MediaProjection Screen Capture Engine (`CaptureService.kt` · `ImageReader` · `VirtualDisplay`)

- **SPEC-04.01:** Receives `MediaProjection` result code and intent data cleanly from `ProjectionActivity`.
- **SPEC-04.02:** Creates Android `VirtualDisplay` matching target aspect ratio scaled cleanly to requested `viewerQuality` width (`360`/`480`/`720`).
- **SPEC-04.03:** Configures `ImageReader.newInstance(width, height, PixelFormat.RGBA_8888, 2)` for minimal frame queuing latency.
- **SPEC-04.04:** Copies pixel stride rows safely without padding distortion into reusable `Bitmap` buffers.
- **SPEC-04.05:** Encodes captured frames to memory-efficient JPEG byte arrays compressed appropriately for mobile bandwidth.
- **SPEC-04.06:** Encodes binary frame bytes into Base64 strings stored in `devices/{deviceId}/frames/live` or `frames/virtual`.
- **SPEC-04.07:** Increments monotonically increasing `seq` counter so controllers discard out-of-order stale packets.
- **SPEC-04.08:** Releases `VirtualDisplay`, `ImageReader`, and `MediaProjection` callbacks cleanly in `onDestroy()`.

#### 24.3.5 Accessibility Gesture & Tree Engine (`RemoteService.kt` · `AccessibilityService` · `GestureDescription`)

- **SPEC-05.01:** Declares `accessibility_config.xml` with `canRetrieveWindowContent=true`, `canPerformGestures=true`, and `flagReportViewIds`.
- **SPEC-05.02:** Maps normalized or absolute viewer touch coordinates onto physical display bounds accurately.
- **SPEC-05.03:** Builds `Path` + `GestureDescription.StrokeDescription` objects for single taps (`80ms`), long presses (`650ms`), and swipes.
- **SPEC-05.04:** Dispatches gestures asynchronously via `dispatchGesture(gesture, callback, null)` on Android API 24+.
- **SPEC-05.05:** Tracks `TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED` events to keep `foregroundPackage` and `foregroundLabel` telemetry fresh.
- **SPEC-05.06:** Walks active root `AccessibilityNodeInfo` hierarchies to locate editable input nodes and clickable elements for AI automation.
- **SPEC-05.07:** Injects text payloads cleanly via `Bundle` (`ACTION_ARGUMENT_SET_TEXT_CHARSEQUENCE`) + `ACTION_SET_TEXT`.
- **SPEC-05.08:** Executes global actions (`BACK`, `HOME`, `RECENTS`, `NOTIFICATIONS`, `QUICK_SETTINGS`, `POWER_DIALOG`, `LOCK_SCREEN`, `TAKE_SCREENSHOT`).

#### 24.3.6 Notification Listener Mirroring (`RemoteNotificationListenerService.kt` · `NotificationListenerService` · `StatusBarNotification`)

- **SPEC-06.01:** Subscribes to active status bar notifications once user enables Notification Access in Android Settings.
- **SPEC-06.02:** Extracts package name, application label, title (`EXTRA_TITLE`), body text (`EXTRA_TEXT`), post timestamp, and ongoing flag.
- **SPEC-06.03:** Filters noisy duplicate system transport notifications cleanly to keep the remote inbox readable.
- **SPEC-06.04:** Builds bounded `RemoteNotificationsPayload` snapshots pushed to `devices/{deviceId}/meta/notifications` on `N:list` requests.
- **SPEC-06.05:** Reports `listenerEnabled` boolean status so remote viewers immediately know whether permission is active.

#### 24.3.7 Messenger Chat & Media Pipeline (`ChatScreen.kt` · `chats` · `PickVisualMedia`)

- **SPEC-07.01:** Computes canonical thread document IDs so both participants always resolve the identical `chats/{chatId}` path.
- **SPEC-07.02:** Observes thread lists and message streams reactively using Firestore `.snapshots()` wrapped in lifecycle-aware ViewModel flows.
- **SPEC-07.03:** Sends UTF-8 text messages validated against length constraints (`<= 2000` chars) with server timestamps.
- **SPEC-07.04:** Uses zero-permission `ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia(ImageOnly)` for photo selection without storage permission dialogs.
- **SPEC-07.05:** Downscales selected gallery images cleanly before Base64 embedding so payload sizes remain well under Firestore document thresholds.
- **SPEC-07.06:** Appends immutable call-summary messages (`AUDIO_CALL`, `VIDEO_CALL`) automatically when calls start or conclude.

#### 24.3.8 Audio & Video Real-Time Calling Engine (`CallMediaEngine.kt` · `AudioRecord` · `CameraStream`)

- **SPEC-08.01:** Initializes `AudioRecord` at 16 kHz / 8 kHz mono PCM tailored for clear low-bandwidth voice transmission.
- **SPEC-08.02:** Configures `AudioTrack` playback buffer cleanly with speakerphone toggle and microphone mute support.
- **SPEC-08.03:** Publishes active stream packets into `chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}/streams/{myUid}` isolated by Firestore rules.
- **SPEC-08.04:** Subscribes to peer stream packets at `chats/{chatId}/calls/{callId}/streams/{peerUid}` for continuous low-latency playback.
- **SPEC-08.05:** Captures front or rear camera preview frames in `VIDEO` call mode with runtime `CAMERA` permission check.
- **SPEC-08.06:** Tears down `AudioRecord`, `AudioTrack`, and camera resources deterministically when call transitions to `ENDED` or `REJECTED`.

#### 24.3.9 AI Voice & Gemini Screen Automation (`GeminiAssistantClient.kt` · `SpeechRecognizer` · `AiScreenPlan`)

- **SPEC-09.01:** Validates `aiSystemEnabled` master flag and non-blank API key before dispatching cloud inference requests.
- **SPEC-09.02:** Captures current UI context summary (clickable labels, editable fields, active package) from `RemoteService`.
- **SPEC-09.03:** Builds structured JSON schema prompts requesting `AiScreenPlan` (`action`, `targetText`, `inputText`, `spokenReply`, `direction`).
- **SPEC-09.04:** Targets `gemini-flash-latest` endpoint with automatic retry on `503` transient demand errors.
- **SPEC-09.05:** Parses fallback replacement model identifiers cleanly if API error JSON suggests a successor model.
- **SPEC-09.06:** Hands resulting actions to `DeviceActionExecutor` for immediate local or remote screen execution.
- **SPEC-09.07:** Reads `spokenReply` aloud using Android `TextToSpeech` with Bengali or English locale matching.

#### 24.3.10 Encrypted Server Vault Module (`SecureServerVault.kt` · `MessageDigest` · `AESVault`)

- **SPEC-10.01:** Stores encrypted vault archive cleanly inside `app/src/main/assets/server_vault_locked.zip`.
- **SPEC-10.02:** Normalizes entered passphrase and computes SHA-256 hash using `java.security.MessageDigest`.
- **SPEC-10.03:** Compares digest against constant-time verified hash before decrypting vault collection/endpoint mappings.
- **SPEC-10.04:** Renders verified server mappings cleanly inside `ServerVaultLockDialog` only while unlocked in memory.
- **SPEC-10.05:** Clears unlocked vault state automatically when dialog dismisses.

## 25. Android API Compatibility, OEM Behavior & Field-Level Validation Reference

### 25.1 Android OS Version Behavioral Matrix (API 26 – API 36)


- **API 26 (Android 8.0 Oreo):** Baseline `minSdk`; requires notification channels for `CloudRelayManager`, `CaptureService`, and `AiOverlayService`; `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW` uses `TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY`.
- **API 27 (Android 8.1 Oreo):** Maintains foreground service notification channels; Credential Manager delegates cleanly to Google Play Services Play Auth.
- **API 28 (Android 9 Pie):** Introduces `AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN` and `GLOBAL_ACTION_TAKE_SCREENSHOT` support plus `FOREGROUND_SERVICE` normal permission.
- **API 29 (Android 10 Q):** Adds scoped storage and background clipboard restrictions; vitRemote safely handles clipboard sync via foreground/accessibility focus and Photo Picker.
- **API 30 (Android 11 R):** Introduces `WindowMetrics` API for exact display dimension inspection and package visibility queries (`QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES` / `<queries>` declarations).
- **API 31 (Android 12 S):** Introduces Material You dynamic color capabilities, approximate/exact notification mutability flags (`FLAG_IMMUTABLE`), and splash guidelines.
- **API 32 (Android 12L):** Improves large-screen foldable/tablet window sizing respected by vitRemote's `widthIn(max = 600.dp)` adaptive layouts.
- **API 33 (Android 13 Tiramisu):** Requires runtime `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` permission for foreground notification visibility and introduces native Photo Picker integration.
- **API 34 (Android 14 UpsideDownCake):** Enforces strict `foregroundServiceType` attributes (`mediaProjection`, `dataSync`, `microphone`, `camera`) and per-session MediaProjection consent.
- **API 35 (Android 15 VanillaIceCream):** Enforces edge-to-edge system bar insets by default; vitRemote enforces `enableEdgeToEdge()` and `WindowInsets.safeDrawing` across every screen.
- **API 36 (Android 16 Baklava):** Current `compileSdk` / `targetSdk`; validated under Robolectric SDK 36 test runner for full forward compatibility.

### 25.2 OEM Background Execution & Battery Preservation Checklist

- **Samsung (One UI):** Settings -> Battery -> Background usage limits -> Never sleeping apps -> Add vitRemote; disable Adaptive Battery throttling for critical relay services.
- **Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (HyperOS / MIUI):** Security -> Permissions -> Autostart -> Enable vitRemote; App Info -> Battery saver -> No restrictions; lock card in Recents.
- **OPPO / Realme (ColorOS / Realme UI):** App Management -> vitRemote -> Battery usage -> Allow background activity & Allow foreground activity; enable Auto-launch.
- **vivo / iQOO (FuntouchOS / OriginOS):** Settings -> Battery -> Background power consumption management -> vitRemote -> High background power consumption.
- **OnePlus (OxygenOS):** Settings -> Battery -> Battery optimization -> vitRemote -> Don't optimize; enable Allow background activity.
- **Google Pixel / Stock Android:** App Info -> App battery usage -> Allow background usage -> Unrestricted.
- **Nothing OS / Motorola / Sony:** App Info -> Battery -> Unrestricted; ensure Accessibility & Notification Access remain toggled ON.

### 25.3 Exhaustive Field-Level Schema & Validation Reference

- **`users.uid`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Must match `request.auth.uid` on creation; immutable thereafter. Purpose: Primary Firebase Authentication identity.
- **`users.email`** (`string (3..160)`, Required): Verified Google account email address. Purpose: Displayed in Host header & Admin directory.
- **`users.displayName`** (`string (0..100)`, Optional): Sanitized human-readable user display name. Purpose: Used in chats and directory cards.
- **`users.lastDeviceId`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Active physical device identifier bound to account. Purpose: Links user record to `devices/{deviceId}`.
- **`users.lastDeviceCode`** (`string (9 digits)`, Required): Strictly matches `^[0-9]{9}$` regex. Purpose: Permanent remote connection code.
- **`users.deviceModel`** (`string (0..120)`, Optional): Manufacturer and model string (e.g., `Samsung SM-S928B`). Purpose: Hardware display badge.
- **`users.androidVersion`** (`string (0..32)`, Optional): OS release string (e.g., `15`). Purpose: Support diagnostics.
- **`users.appVersion`** (`string (0..32)`, Optional): Installed `versionName` string. Purpose: Minimum version diagnostics.
- **`users.role`** (`string`, Required): Always `'user'` for client registrations; immutable to non-admins. Purpose: Access-control tier.
- **`users.blocked`** (`bool`, Required): Always `false` on client registration; mutable by admins only. Purpose: Account access switch.
- **`users.blockReason`** (`string (0..300)`, Required): Empty string by default; populated when blocked. Purpose: Notice shown on blocked UI.
- **`users.lastSeenAt`** (`timestamp`, Required): Must be `<= request.time`. Purpose: Last active session pulse.
- **`users.createdAt`** (`timestamp`, Required): Server creation timestamp. Purpose: Account creation record.
- **`users.updatedAt`** (`timestamp`, Required): Server modification timestamp. Purpose: Latest sync timestamp.
- **`deviceBindings.deviceId`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Must match document ID. Purpose: Unique device hardware UUID.
- **`deviceBindings.ownerUid`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Must match creator UID; cannot be hijacked. Purpose: Enforces 1-account-per-device.
- **`deviceBindings.ownerEmail`** (`string (3..160)`, Required): Bound email shown on ownership mismatch lock screen. Purpose: Helpful recovery hint.
- **`deviceBindings.deviceCode`** (`string (9 digits)`, Required): Permanent 9-digit connection code. Purpose: Restored after app reinstall.
- **`deviceBindings.deviceModel`** (`string (0..120)`, Optional): Hardware model snapshot. Purpose: Device identification.
- **`deviceBindings.createdAt`** (`timestamp`, Required): Immutable creation timestamp. Purpose: Binding audit time.
- **`deviceBindings.updatedAt`** (`timestamp`, Required): Server timestamp on sync. Purpose: Latest binding verification.
- **`deviceCodes.code`** (`string (9 digits)`, Required): Must match document ID (`^[0-9]{9}$`). Purpose: Direct lookup key.
- **`deviceCodes.deviceId`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Target `devices/{deviceId}` path key. Purpose: Resolves remote host.
- **`deviceCodes.ownerUid`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Owner UID matching `deviceBindings`. Purpose: Ownership cross-check.
- **`deviceCodes.deviceModel`** (`string (0..120)`, Optional): Model label returned upon lookup. Purpose: UI preview before session.
- **`deviceCodes.createdAt`** (`timestamp`, Required): Server timestamp. Purpose: Lookup creation time.
- **`devices.ownerUid`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Bound Google account UID. Purpose: Controls write access.
- **`devices.deviceCode`** (`string (9 digits)`, Required): Must match 9-digit code pattern. Purpose: Authorizes remote viewers.
- **`devices.model`** (`string (1..120)`, Required): Hardware brand + model string. Purpose: Displayed in device lists.
- **`devices.deviceAlias`** (`string (0..80)`, Optional): User-configured custom nickname. Purpose: Personalization label.
- **`devices.androidVersion`** (`string (1..32)`, Optional): Android OS version string. Purpose: Compatibility badge.
- **`devices.sdk`** (`int (21..60)`, Required): Integer Android SDK level. Purpose: Feature capability flag.
- **`devices.online`** (`bool`, Required): True while `CloudRelayManager` is actively syncing. Purpose: Online/offline indicator.
- **`devices.cloudEnabled`** (`bool`, Required): Host master remote sharing toggle. Purpose: Instant privacy kill-switch.
- **`devices.videoStreaming`** (`bool`, Required): Indicates active `CaptureService` projection. Purpose: Stream readiness flag.
- **`devices.screenWidth`** (`int (>0)`, Required): Host screen pixel width. Purpose: Touch scaling denominator.
- **`devices.screenHeight`** (`int (>0)`, Required): Host screen pixel height. Purpose: Touch scaling denominator.
- **`devices.batteryLevel`** (`int (-1..100)`, Required): Current charge percentage or `-1` if unknown. Purpose: Telemetry gauge.
- **`devices.batteryTempTenths`** (`int`, Required): Battery temperature in 0.1°C units. Purpose: Thermal monitor.
- **`devices.charging`** (`bool`, Required): True when plugged into charger/USB. Purpose: Power indicator.
- **`devices.ramUsedMb`** (`int (>=0)`, Required): Active memory footprint in megabytes. Purpose: Performance gauge.
- **`devices.ramTotalMb`** (`int (>=0)`, Required): Total device RAM in megabytes. Purpose: Performance denominator.
- **`devices.storageUsedMb`** (`int (>=0)`, Required): Consumed internal flash storage in MB. Purpose: Storage monitor.
- **`devices.storageTotalMb`** (`int (>=0)`, Required): Total internal flash storage in MB. Purpose: Storage denominator.
- **`devices.brightness`** (`int (-1..255)`, Required): Current display backlight value. Purpose: Remote brightness slider.
- **`devices.torchOn`** (`bool`, Required): Rear camera flashlight active status. Purpose: Torch button state.
- **`devices.ringing`** (`bool`, Required): Find-phone ringtone playback status. Purpose: Ring toggle state.
- **`devices.clipboardText`** (`string (0..2000)`, Optional): Latest pulled host clipboard string. Purpose: Clipboard inspector.
- **`devices.captureMode`** (`string`, Optional): Current capture source mode (`screen` or `virtual`). Purpose: Viewer state indicator.
- **`devices.viewerActive`** (`bool`, Required): True while an authorized viewer is connected. Purpose: Host status warning.
- **`devices.viewerQuality`** (`int`, Required): Active stream width tier (`360`, `480`, or `720`). Purpose: Adaptive quality setting.
- **`devices.virtualScreenActive`** (`bool`, Required): True when Virtual Screen session is open. Purpose: Virtual display flag.
- **`devices.virtualScreenPackage`** (`string`, Optional): Package ID running in Virtual Screen. Purpose: Active virtual app name.
- **`devices.virtualScreenStatus`** (`string`, Optional): Virtual display status text. Purpose: Status diagnostics.
- **`devices.foregroundPackage`** (`string`, Optional): Currently visible foreground package on host. Purpose: Live activity awareness.
- **`devices.foregroundLabel`** (`string`, Optional): Human-readable name of foreground app. Purpose: Live UI indicator.
- **`devices.foregroundChangedAtMs`** (`int (>=0)`, Optional): Epoch ms timestamp of last foreground switch. Purpose: App transition tracking.
- **`frames.ownerUid`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Device owner UID. Purpose: Stream ownership lock.
- **`frames.seq`** (`int (>=0)`, Required): Monotonic frame sequence number. Purpose: Drops stale packets.
- **`frames.width`** (`int (>0)`, Required): Encoded image width in pixels. Purpose: Aspect calculation.
- **`frames.height`** (`int (>0)`, Required): Encoded image height in pixels. Purpose: Aspect calculation.
- **`frames.isFullShot`** (`bool`, Required): True on forced full-frame sync (`c`). Purpose: Refresh marker.
- **`frames.imageBase64`** (`string`, Required): Compressed JPEG Base64 payload. Purpose: Rendered frame bitmap.
- **`commands.senderUid`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Authenticated sender Firebase UID. Purpose: Audit traceability.
- **`commands.senderDeviceId`** (`string (1..128)`, Required): Originating controller device ID. Purpose: Loopback diagnostics.
- **`commands.pin`** (`string (9 digits)`, Required): Must match target `devices/{deviceId}.deviceCode`. Purpose: Zero-trust command auth.
- **`commands.payload`** (`string (1..1000)`, Required): Validated command opcode and arguments. Purpose: Executed by Relay/RemoteService.
- **`commands.status`** (`string`, Required): Initialized as `'pending'`; transitions to `'done'` or `'error'`. Purpose: Execution receipt.
- **`commands.errorMessage`** (`string?`, Optional): Failure explanation if execution threw exception. Purpose: Viewer feedback banner.
- **`chats.participants`** (`list[2 strings]`, Required): Sorted two-UID array scoping read/write access. Purpose: Participant isolation.
- **`chats.participantNames`** (`map<uid, string>`, Optional): Display labels for each thread participant. Purpose: Conversation header.
- **`chats.lastMessage`** (`string`, Optional): Latest message preview shown in Chat list. Purpose: Thread summary.
- **`chats.activeCallId`** (`string?`, Optional): Active call document ID if ringing/in-progress. Purpose: Incoming call trigger.
- **`chats.activeCallType`** (`string?`, Optional): `AUDIO` or `VIDEO` when call is active. Purpose: Incoming call badge.
- **`chats.activeCallCallerUid`** (`string?`, Optional): UID of call initiator. Purpose: Ringing notification logic.
